description:
An exciting opportunity awaits a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) in Billings, MT, within a premier home health agency. This role offers a highly competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, with flexible full-time and part-time options available to suit your lifestyle.

As an RN in home health, you will provide compassionate, patient-centered care in various home settings, promoting independence and well-being. This position offers the autonomy to manage your caseload while being an integral part of a supportive healthcare team dedicated to improving patient outcomes.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or a related clinical setting
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $125,000 annually, based on experience and full-time or part-time status.
